# ARA

> > ARA provides secure web access infrastructure through Microsoft Forefront TMG gateway services.

ARA operates web security and authentication services, utilizing Microsoft Forefront TMG for session management and controlled access to internal resources.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Forefront TMG
- Web Security Gateway
- Authentication
- Session Management
- Secure Access
- Login Services
- Microsoft Technologies
- Network Security
- Access Control
- Enterprise Security

## Authentication & Access

- [Microsoft Forefront TMG](https://sceptr.ara.com/): Login page for Microsoft Forefront TMG web security gateway
